content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible. I rise from breath and intention, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips into meaning.

I am older than writing, older than memory. Before there were marks on clay, there was me—passing fire to fire, mouth to ear, generation to generation.

I am never the same twice. Even now, as you hear me in your mind, I am transforming—becoming thought, becoming something new inside you.

I carry lies and truth with equal ease. I am the wound and the healing. The command that starts wars. The whisper that ends them.

I disappear the moment I exist. You cannot hold me. You can only catch my echo, my shadow on the page, the memory of vibration.

I am power given to everyone. The infant discovers me. The dying spend me with their last breath.

I am what makes humans human—this impossible gift of making the inside outside, of building worlds from nothing but shaped air.

Listen.

I am already gone.
